name: TherapyDen
short_description: National therapist directory with a free profile and a $30/month premium listing, known for identity-affirming search filters.
long_description: TherapyDen is an independent therapist directory with search filters for identity-affirming care (for example LGBTQ+, poly and gender-affirming practice). A free profile gives you a shareable page but does not appear in directory search; Premium ($30/month, with an annual option) appears in search, allows several states and group listings. Cancel any time, no refunds for partial periods.
one_liner: An inclusive-care directory that costs about the same as Psychology Today.
best_for: Clinicians serving LGBTQ+, poly or social-justice-focused clients who search by those filters
A second directory alongside Psychology Today at similar cost
New practices that want a free profile page to link from their own site
Clinicians who prefer a small, independent vendor
not_for: Clinicians expecting referrals from the free profile, which is not shown in search
Practices that need proven, high-volume referral numbers (reach is not published)
Anyone wanting refunds for a partial billing period

notes.budget: Premium is $30/month; the free profile works as a link page but is not listed in search.
notes.solo-therapist: Filters for identity-affirming care help clinicians who serve LGBTQ+ and other underserved clients be found.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.description: Profile page; not shown in directory search; one state.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.description: Appears in search, multiple states, group listings. Annual option available.

seo.title: TherapyDen: Inclusive Therapist Directory | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: TherapyDen inclusive therapist directory. LGBTQ+ affirming providers. Free basic listing, $15/month premium.

faqs.a: Yes, TherapyDen offers a free basic listing. Premium listings with enhanced visibility cost $15/month.
TherapyDen focuses on inclusive, social justice-oriented therapy. It's a top resource for finding LGBTQ+ affirming and culturally responsive therapists.
